data.name: Call of Farming : Together
data.detailed_description:
🚜 CALL OF FARMING: TOGETHER

Call of Farming: Together is a comprehensive farming simulation with deep mechanics where you can build your own world in the heart of nature. In this version, you'll lay the foundations of your dream farm, cultivate the land, and master the art of survival. Strategize alone or via a local network; take your first step towards becoming the most successful farmer in the valley!

🌟 KEY GAME DYNAMICS

Deep Farming and Livestock: Cultivate the soil, sow your seeds, and water your crops to grow. Farm a wide range of crops, from strawberries and tomatoes to wheat and squash, while raising animals like cows, sheep, chickens, and pigs to liven up your farm.

Advanced Camera and Viewing System: Your view is never interrupted as you pass through houses or navigate between town models. Thanks to our intelligent camera system, obstacles become transparent, always giving you the best angle.

Crafting and Building: Build your own structures with the resources you gather (wood, rock, straw). Customize your farm completely to your needs, from fences and barbecue areas to chests and special shelters.

Survival and Development: Balance your character's health, hunger, and thirst. Protect yourself from the cold using heat sources and unlock new bonus effects by improving your skills with the leveling system (XP).

🛠️ DETAILED MECHANICS

Inventory and Equipment: Manage the resources you gather in an advanced inventory system. Dominate nature with tools like hoes, scythes, axes, pickaxes, and fishing rods.

Hunting and Fishing: Don't just farm! Fish in lakes or hunt in the wilderness, tracking animals like deer, bears, and squirrels.

Culinary Arts: Carry the fruits, apples, and meats you gather to the kitchen. Refresh your energy by cooking delicious meals like tacos, popcorn, and bread.

Dynamic World: Manage time with the day/night cycle and game clock. Develop your strategy by considering the durability of your crops and the spoilage times of food.

Friendly Pets and Protection: Take your pets with you; they can attack for you, chase enemies, and even help you by digging.

🏘️ A LIVING TOWN ATMOSPHERE

With town models, streetlights, benches, and shop stands, the game world is more than just a field! With custom 2D icons and animated male/female characters designed for interactive models, you'll feel like you're part of a real community. Whether you defend yourself with melee or ranged attacks, a new adventure awaits you at every turn in this valley.
